statements.status_notes: Vulnerable code not present: the pixman stress-test binary under upstream test/ is not installed into libpixman-1-0 or libpixman-1-dev (only libpixman-1.so.*, headers, and pkg-config ship). Debian: "Crash in test tool, no security impact" — https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2023-37769
